name: Sign Up: Split
summary: A two-column sign-up form with neutral provider buttons, a password strength meter measured from the password, a terms checkbox and a highlights and testimonial panel.
useWhen: Creating accounts for a product that needs a name, work email and a password at sign-up
Showing a password strength meter and an explicit terms agreement before account creation
avoidWhen: The product signs people up through a single provider or a magic link; use a shorter sign-up instead
Sign-in for existing accounts only; use sign-in-split, where the form is shorter
